compiled_state.description:
## Context
ADR 0096 is merged as Gerrit change 1775 and approves a two-cadence Pandoc verification boundary. Gerrit Verify currently still performs complete live-Pandoc corpus work. Run 31798375024 attributed a 184.32-second macOS lower bound to two visible corpus phases. The implementation must reduce per-change subprocess work without removing any behavioral assertion, contractual assertion, supported Python cell, supported operating system, or complete real-Pandoc replay.

## Plan
- Extend scripts/generate_dc_wiki_legacy_outputs.py so deterministic committed artifacts cover every Pandoc-bound input encountered by the complete corpus through all required settling passes. Split artifacts by corpus stratum when needed to remain below repository file-size limits. Preserve the frozen Pandoc 3.6.1 contract plus the Linux x86_64 and Darwin arm64 binary SHA-256 values.
- Add a test-only static converter backed by those committed artifacts. Drive the production segmenting renderer through that converter for all corpus cardinality, scrubbing, protection, table, HTML-comment, settling, richness, alignment, byte-output, dispatch, fallback, and immutability assertions in Gerrit Verify.
- Retain one deterministic live product-path body from each code_arrow, table, and prose stratum. Select bodies that exercise conversion, protected fallback, and fixed-point behavior. Retain the compact installed-version, platform-fingerprint, argv, stdin, timeout, and non-vacuous-dispatch probes.
- Add an explicit full-replay mode that exercises every corpus unit and settling pass through the installed real Pandoc.
- Add a dedicated pandoc-corpus-replay job to .github/workflows/external-integration.yml with ubuntu-latest and macos-latest matrix arms. Run full replay on the existing weekly schedule and workflow_dispatch path.
- Keep deterministic regeneration documented in the generator help. Add a non-writing check path for validating committed fixture bytes.
- Update docs/architecture.md after the route changes from transitional to active.
- Measure paired focused before/after wall time on the same host. Record the first genuine Gerrit Verify timing after merge.
- Back-out is a Gerrit revert of this implementation, restoring complete live replay in every Verify run.

## Verification
- Run generator unit tests.
- Run corpus plus hardening suites in default static mode.
- Run corpus plus hardening suites in full-replay mode.
- Run workflow policy tests, lint, typecheck, and the full default test gate.
- Require Gerrit LLM-Review +1.
- Require Gerrit Verified +1.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Gerrit Verify broad corpus assertions use committed deterministic Pandoc outputs.
- [ ] Every existing corpus assertion class remains present in Gerrit Verify.
- [ ] Every supported Python matrix cell still runs the broad corpus assertions.
- [ ] Every supported operating-system cell still runs the broad corpus assertions.
- [ ] Gerrit Verify runs one real product-path body from code_arrow.
- [ ] Gerrit Verify runs one real product-path body from table.
- [ ] Gerrit Verify runs one real product-path body from prose.
- [ ] The compact Pandoc version probe remains in Gerrit Verify.
- [ ] The compact platform fingerprint probe remains in Gerrit Verify.
- [ ] The committed artifacts identify Pandoc 3.6.1.
- [ ] The committed artifacts identify the Linux x86_64 binary SHA-256.
- [ ] The committed artifacts identify the Darwin arm64 binary SHA-256.
- [ ] Fixture regeneration is deterministic.
- [ ] Fixture validation has a non-writing command.
- [ ] External Integration Tests contains a pandoc-corpus-replay job.
- [ ] The replay job contains an ubuntu-latest matrix arm.
- [ ] The replay job contains a macos-latest matrix arm.
- [ ] The replay job executes every corpus unit through real Pandoc.
- [ ] The replay job executes every required settling pass through real Pandoc.
- [ ] The replay job runs from the weekly workflow schedule.
- [ ] The replay job runs from workflow_dispatch.
- [ ] A pin mismatch fails before committed outputs are trusted.
- [ ] A platform fingerprint mismatch fails before committed outputs are trusted.
- [ ] Paired same-host A/B evidence is recorded on this ticket.
- [ ] A genuine Gerrit Verify timing is recorded on this ticket.
- [ ] The implementation passes LLM-Review +1.
- [ ] The implementation passes Verified +1.
- [ ] The implementation merges before this ticket closes.
